methods.name: Quest skip to level 34
methods.note: Client of Kourend's two lamps, The Ascent of Arceuus, Enter the Abyss, Temple of the Eye and The Eyes of Glouphrie reach 32. The Slug Menace makes 34.

methods.name: Earth talisman tiaras
methods.note: An earth talisman used on the Earth Altar with a tiara, about 1,300 an hour with the ring of the elements. Only earth talismans sell in bulk; lavas are faster from 25.

methods.name: Arceuus Library books
methods.note: Each book handed in gives 5 times your Runecraft level, about 136 books an hour with a library plugin and stamina potions. No essence needed.

methods.name: Ourania Altar
methods.note: Ourania Teleport and every pouch, repaired by Astral Contact after Enter the Abyss; about 48 seconds a lap. Profitable, and daeyalt essence gives 50% more XP.

methods.name: Lava runes with Magic Imbue
methods.note: Earth runes on the Fire Altar after Magic Imbue, a binding necklace and every pouch (the colossal from 85); repairs need Enter the Abyss. A small profit.

methods.name: Lava runes with earth talismans
methods.note: The same laps without Lunar spells: one to three earth talismans a lap, pouches repaired by Cordelia or the Dark Mage after Enter the Abyss. About 2 coins an XP.

methods.name: Guardians of the Rift
methods.note: No essence needed: mine fragments, craft at the open altars and get 45 XP a level each time the rift closes. The colossal pouch's 40 essence from 85 lifts the rate.
methods.src: Guide:Solo GOTR guide - 100%* win rate and 10+ points per game on average

methods.name: Royal Titans desiccated pages
methods.note: Take pages instead of loot from the Royal Titans and imbue them at a plinth for 50 XP each. About 17,000 an hour in a duo with high combat stats; the pages sell.

methods.name: Arceuus blood runes, soul runes at 90
methods.note: Mine dense essence, bless it at the Dark Altar, chisel and craft. Rates assume the medium Kourend & Kebos Diary and running between, about 7.5 trips an hour.

methods.name: Double astral runes
methods.note: Tele Group Moonclan to the altar and a ring of dueling to Castle Wars, with every pouch; repairs need Enter the Abyss. Profitable; Teleport to Boat is faster.

methods.name: Aether runes
methods.req: q:Fairytale II - Cure a Queen|Lunar Diplomacy;s:magic 82,agility 66
methods.note: Soul runes on the Cosmic Altar after Magic Imbue, with aether catalysts, the colossal pouch and a fairy ring to Zanaris. Fairytale II started is enough.

methods.name: Wrath runes
methods.note: Mythical cape to the Myths' Guild and past the dragons with dragonfire protection, about 72 trips of 66 essence an hour. Profitable.

unverified: Quest skip to level 34: Client of Kourend's two 500 XP lamps, The Ascent of Arceuus 500, Enter the Abyss 1,000, Temple of the Eye 9,210 in all (5,000 on completion and 4,210 during the quest), The Eyes of Glouphrie 6,000 reach 17,710, level 32; The Slug Menace (30 Runecraft) adds 3,500, level 34; X Marks the Spot's 300 lamp is spare; What Lies Below (8,000) needs 35; the app's quest data counts Temple of the Eye as 5,000; no hourly rate, so never dealt

Earth talisman tiaras: 85% of the guide's 'up to around 1,550' tiaras an hour at 32.5 XP; the guide's 1,450 is the practised figure and no other page times the method (single source); fire talismans cost 4,456 and 176 trade a day, earth 620 and 16,058; 21.7 coins an XP at 20 October 2026 prices

Arceuus Library: 85% of the 160 books an hour the Ironman Guide gives with stamina potions (the main guide 150 to 160 with client plugins, 90 to 100 without; the Ultimate Ironman Guide 150 and 100); Magic's library entry uses 120 books an hour for the same activity (Ironman Guide/Magic: 120 with the plugin, 150 with stamina), so the two skills differ for the same hour

Ourania Altar: 85% of 1.05 x the altar page's formula (XP an essence from the rune distribution, the pouch essence of each level, 48 s a lap, Astral Contact time); the page calls tick-perfect play about 5% higher (its comment says 3%); 80-89 uses the distribution's 14.82 XP an essence where the page's table says 14.90; 71 Magic is for Ourania Teleport, and tablets (Lunar Diplomacy too) avoid it at the cost of a slot; daeyalt essence for an ironman: 1.5 / (1 + essence used / shards mined) of the pure rate, 0.71 at 4,867 essence and 4,400 shards an hour

Lava runes (both entries): 85% of the guide's model's maximum (best lap + 0.87 ticks, the table's essence), which the guide puts 9 to 12% above its practical table; with equipped teleports the guide gives 112,981 at 85 (85% would be 96,000); bands below 85 use the best set of separate pouches, 85 assumes the colossal pouch (Temple of the Eye, 56 Crafting and the abyssal needle, 750 abyssal pearls); lava runes make a small profit at 25 coins a rune and break even at about 16.5 (85, the colossal pouch, seven stamina doses an hour)

Guardians of the Rift: 85% of the solo guide's timed games from 27 (34,000 over 2.5 hours) and from 85 (65,000 over 87 minutes); 85% of Wise Old Man's efficient 45,000 from 50; the guide's 50,000 from 75, which the game's XP a game at 6.5 games an hour also gives; the guide's table dates from May 2022 and predates the rework of 13 November 2024; a reader measured about 30,000 at 75 and 34,000 at 80 (November 2024), 40% under the 75 band; mass worlds scale the Great Guardian by players, so game length varies

Royal Titans desiccated pages: 48 kills an hour in a duo (the money making guide) x 7.25 pages x 50 XP = 17,400; the guide says about 20,000 (single source); the kill rate needs high combat stats and gear, which req cannot state, and the fight is meant for two players of 90 combat or more

Arceuus blood and soul runes: the guide's 36,000 and 44,000 (7.5 trips an hour 'at average speeds' in the money making guides) are under 85% of a rebuild from 9 ticks a block and the map distances (39,300 and 46,700), so they stand; they assume the medium Kourend & Kebos Diary (5% double blocks) and 73 Agility for the rock shortcut, neither in req; the elite diary, the blisterwood lantern and blood essence add runes, not XP

Double astral runes: 85% of the guide's 59,000 at 99, scaled to 82 and 85 by its own table; the money making guide's 76 trips banking on Lunar Isle give 43,600 at 85 (9.7% under 48,300); Moonclan Teleport needs 69 Magic and Tele Group Moonclan 70, which req does not ask (tablets serve a main)

Aether runes: 85% of the guide's 104,000 at 99 scaled to 99,000/102,000 before 99; an anonymous reader puts tick-perfect play before 99 at 85,000-86,000, which would make 85% about 73,000; the rate assumes the colossal pouch (the guide gives 70,000 without it); Fairytale II only has to be started, which req cannot say, so req asks for the whole quest; profit is slim (about 43 coins a rune)

Wrath runes: 85% of the guide's 'up to around 44,880' (85 runs of 66 essence); the cape makes 90 to 96 trips possible (money making guide); the colossal pouch's 66 essence assumes Temple of the Eye, which req does not ask

Enter the Abyss is not in req for the methods that rate essence pouches (Ourania, both lava entries, astral, aether, wrath), though no pouch can be repaired without it (the Dark Mage answers Astral Contact only after it, and Cordelia needs Temple of the Eye): beside Lunar Diplomacy it makes the count of questions over the card grow, which a test pins as impossible, so the notes name it as Smithing's do The Giant Dwarf; an account without it is rated with pouches it cannot keep from 25

Not included: essence runners (280,000 with four at about 12,000,000 coins an hour each, 171 coins an XP; duo 162,000; aethers 345,000 with six); mud, steam, smoke and mist runes (up to 3.9% under lava runes at the same laps, profitable); double nature runes (31,680 at 91; 69,120 with the achievement diary cape, which needs every diary); double law runes (37,620 to 50,160 from 95, Teleport to Boat and 75 Sailing); double cosmic runes (15,480 to 32,160); the true Blood Altar (49,245, Sins of the Father); sunfire runes (9 XP an essence, each needing sunfire splinters from the Colosseum, and twisted extracts to make a profit); sulphurous essence and elemental amulets (by-products)
